root.title: CSG2305 Digital Forensics
root.desc: Complete forensic investigation lifecycle: identification, preservation, analysis, and testimony.

children.title: Evidence Intake & Preservation
children.desc: Order of Volatility (RFC 3227), cryptographic hashing, hardware write-blocking, and strict Chain of Custody.

children.title: Order of Volatility (RFC 3227)
children.desc: RAM -> Swap/Pagefile -> Network Sockets -> File System -> Archival Media.

children.title: Cryptographic Integrity
children.desc: MD5 + SHA-256 match before and after acquisition proves zero bit alteration.

children.title: Hardware Write-Blocking
children.desc: Physical bridge intercepts ATA/SCSI write commands at firmware level.

children.title: Chain of Custody (CoC)
children.desc: Tamper-evident evidence bags, transfer sign-offs, and vault logs.

children.title: Windows OS Artifacts
children.desc: Forensic evidence of program execution, file opening, folder navigation, and removable USB storage.

children.title: USBSTOR Registry Hive
children.desc: Hardware vendor, model, unique device serial, first/last connection times.

children.title: Prefetch Files (.pf)
children.desc: Proves binary execution, run counter, last 8 launch timestamps, loaded DLLs.

children.title: Shellbags & LNK Shortcuts
children.desc: Reconstructs folder browsing habits even after directories are deleted.

children.title: Recycle Bin ($I & $R)
children.desc: $I stores original path & delete timestamp; $R holds raw deleted payload.

children.title: File Systems & Data Carving
children.desc: Low-level NTFS / FAT structures, timestamp comparison, slack space, and file header/footer carving.

children.title: NTFS Master File Table ($MFT)
children.desc: Compares $STANDARD_INFORMATION vs $FILE_NAME to flag timestomping drift.

children.title: Slack Space & Unallocated Sectors
children.desc: RAM slack & Drive slack: recovering fragmented clusters from past writes.

children.title: Magic Byte File Carving
children.desc: Extracts deleted files without metadata (JPEG: FF D8 FF, PDF: %PDF-, ZIP: PK..).

children.title: Timeline & Expert Reporting
children.desc: Correlating disparate clues into a single chronological MACB narrative for judicial scrutiny.

children.title: MACB Super-Timeline
children.desc: Unified timeline: Modified, Accessed, Changed (MFT), and Born timestamps.

children.title: Dual-Tool Verification
children.desc: Cross-validating findings with independent tools (Autopsy + Eric Zimmerman).

children.title: Fact vs. Inference Reporting
children.desc: State only verifiable technical observations without ungrounded speculation.

children.title: Recommended Toolchain
children.desc: Forensic analysis suites recommended for coursework labs and practical assessments.

children.title: Autopsy (The Workhorse)
children.desc: Ingests E01/RAW images, keyword indexer, EXIF parser, web artifact analyzer.

children.title: FTK Imager Lite
children.desc: Bitstream forensic imaging, physical memory capture, raw drive mounting.

children.title: Eric Zimmerman Suite
children.desc: PECmd (Prefetch), JLECmd (JumpLists), SBECmd (ShellBags) precision CLI tools.
